blueprints.description: Bookings for shared rooms, equipment and vehicles: a booking calendar, a booking list, a booking page, the resources and a wizard that books one in four steps.

screens.name: bookings.calendar
screens.title: Calendar
screens.description: Every booking on a calendar: who has what, and when.

screens.name: bookings.list
screens.title: Bookings
screens.description: Every booking with its resource, time and status.

screens.name: bookings.record
screens.title: Booking
screens.description: One booking: key facts, its attendees, its extras and its activity.

screens.name: bookings.resources
screens.title: Resources
screens.description: The rooms, equipment and vehicles that can be booked.

screens.name: bookings.new
screens.title: New booking
screens.description: Book a room, equipment or a vehicle in four short steps.

templates.name: BookingsCalendar
templates.description: Every booking on the day it falls, on a month, a week or as an agenda, with the status told in words.

templates.name: BookingsList
templates.description: Every booking with its resource, who booked it, date and time and status, filtered by resource, status, person and date.

templates.name: BookingPage
templates.description: One booking: status, date, hours and people, its details, attendees and extras, and its activity.

templates.name: ResourcesList
templates.description: The rooms, equipment and vehicles that can be booked, with their capacity, location and whether each is free.

templates.name: NewBookingWizard
templates.description: Resource, time, details, then review and book; the step survives a refresh and an invalid step blocks Next and says why.

templates.name: BookingsQuickCreateBooking
templates.description: A short form that creates one booking without leaving the page.
